TEXT:
Akihabara is especially bustling during summer 
holidays.

There's a child showing interest in otaku goods 
stores-
And a father quietly educating him-
Seeing this scenario unfold, I let out a wry smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hey! Kyousuke-shi!
I heard a familiar voice from afar.

When I looked back, I saw Saori approaching me 
while waving her hand, donning the "uniform" of 
the area.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
My pardons for being late. My preparations took 
longer than anticipated.
-It's been a while, indeed.

Is what I almost blurted out, but Saori and 
Bajeena are one and the same.

So I decided to speak to her, in a tone as if you 
were complimenting someone appearing different 
from usual.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So you're Bajeena today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Yes! That's because today's date will unfold in this 
stage that's Akiba!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Or...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Could it be that you aren't pleased with dating this 
side of me in particular?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, nothing like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This version of you suits me well too.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Mufu~ ＠ω＠

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now! Let us depart at once, Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey!

Check out how positive she is. Such a huge 
difference.

I can't picture that shy lady and this person are the 
very same.
She's even getting me worked up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Woah! Over here, Kyousuke-shi!

Saori was immediately fixated over this plastic 
model showcase.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That red robot is really flashy.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
This is the dream mobile suit the Major piloted in 
the light novel♪

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Even this has materialized into 3D... 
fu[font_size=26]fu[/font_size][font_size=18]fu[/font_size]fu, splendid.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Huh... Is this something only rabid fans can 
appreciate?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
This item can only exist through the fruits of labor 
of a fan.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
This is naturally making my mouth bigger and my 
wallet smaller!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now, onto the next store!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I got it, I got it. Don't pull.
Saori sure is acting like a kid today.
